text: Constant `ptrtoint`/`inttoptr` shall require complete numeric evaluation under the bound profile without unresolved final global addresses. Symbolic integer-address relocations, arbitrary arithmetic on unresolved addresses, and arbitrary linker-side expression evaluation shall be rejected.
